summary_en: Upper limit 1,500,000 shares (2.37% of S/O ex-treasury) and ¥5.0B. Acquisition window 10 Aug 2026–31 Jan 2027. Ordinary shares. Rationale: enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, Taikisha Ltd.'s board of directors resolved to acquire its own ordinary shares under Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied by Article 165(3)). The acquisition framework authorizes purchase of up to 1,500,000 shares for an aggregate amount not exceeding ¥5.0 billion, with an execution window from 10 August 2026 to 31 January 2027. The 1,500,000-share limit represents 2.37% of the 63,418,513 shares outstanding (ex-treasury) as of 31 July 2026. The company states the buyback is intended to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency while enabling flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. No individual share price ceiling was disclosed; the ¥5.0B upper limit is the sole price constraint.
